decisions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>it</u>이(가) 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?
decisions.analysis:
✅ ① 새 시작과 연관된 날짜 ←정답 (it = date associated with new beginning)
❌ ② 봄의 첫날 — 문맥상 지시 대상 아님
❌ ③ 3월 셋째 목요일 — 문맥상 지시 대상 아님
❌ ④ 특별한 날짜 — 문맥상 지시 대상 아님
decisions.korean: it = date associated with new beginning
decisions.tip: 대명사의 지시 대상은 문맥상 의미 연결로 판단한다.
decisions.passage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as “the first day of spring”), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as “the third Thursday in March”). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. Meaningful dates can thus serve as catalysts for behavioral change.
